description.zh:
京杭大运河肇始于隋代通济渠、永济渠与江南河，元代开凿会通河、通惠河后形成北京至杭州的南北水运干线，明清两代长期承担漕运，至清末漕运停止后逐渐衰落。

> 本数据为 M75 示例初稿：路线为示意简化，事件日期、地点与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
The Grand Canal began with the Sui dynasty’s Tongji, Yongji, and Jiangnan canals. After the Yuan dynasty opened the Huitong and Tonghui canals, it formed a north-south waterway from Beijing to Hangzhou. It carried grain taxes through the Ming and Qing dynasties and declined after the grain transport system ended in the late Qing.

> M75 illustrative draft: routes are simplified; dates, places, and wording await historical review.

description.zh: 中国古代南北水运干线，连接北京与杭州。
description.en: The ancient north-south waterway connecting Beijing and Hangzhou.
